description: A processor treats fields whose names begin with x- as extensions, and an x- field changes the meaning of no core field.
notes: These validity fixtures exercise OBI-T-03/c1 for validators: a document carrying x- members is judged as the same document without them, so it stays conformant. OBI-T-03/c2 (no x- field changes a core field's meaning) is exercised by the scenarios in scenarios/OBI-T-03.json, which observe resolution, the version decision, value validation, and kind comparison.
